docs.title: FOAF Pattern
docs.text:
This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Agent
  • Document
  • Group
  • Image
  • Label Property
  • Online Account
  • Online Chat Account
  • Online Ecommerce Account
  • Online Gaming Account
  • Organization
  • Person
  • Personal Profile Document
  • Project

The formal definition of this pattern is available in OWL Syntax.
